product.name: Linen washcloth, pair
product.description: Give it half a day at a wash house, and batch cedar drawer twenty two stays with a flat mailer.

blocks.text: You will find linen cloths and not much else, packed Wednesday as batch tin stall forty eight.
The crew at the cutting table uses a cold rinse for this, and this one is batch harbor crate sixty one.
Hand hemming on Wednesday is how the wash crew still finishes these, batch hemp crock thirty five.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

trick.instruction: Notice Picking labor at twenty dollars and fifty seven cents. Continue only when the errand still fits with that charge included.
